english.note: Use 識 when you are acquainted or familiar with a person, place, or thing.

examples.english: I know this restaurant; the food is really good.
examples.traditional: 我識呢間餐廳，啲嘢食好好食。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sik1 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 hou2 sik6

boxes.meaning: to know how to do something

english.note: Use this for knowing how to do something or being able to handle it properly, as in knowing how to complete an assignment.

examples.english: I understand how to do this assignment.
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3 ngo5 sik1 zou6
